title: milestone_window_ticks validator cap (10000) rejects the documented full-game tuning range (12 min @ 20 Hz = 14400)
evidence:
core/catalog.odin:937: `if b.advance.milestone_window_ticks < 1 || b.advance.milestone_window_ticks > 10000 {`
data/balance.json:45 (the advance block's own _comment): `"_comment": "Story 6.2 era-advance gate (GDD M4 / arch \u00a76.6): the modernization gate's tunables. milestone_window_ticks = the era's milestone sustain window (the window the player must hold per-class SLA >= sla_uptime_pct to advance \u2014 prototype value 600 = 30s @ 20Hz; the GDD full-game assumption is ~8-12 min/era [ASSUMPTION: prototype tuning]); ..."`
data/balance.json:2: `"logic_hz": 20,`
detail: The catalog documents the full-game window as ~8-12 min/era; at the pinned 20 Hz that is 9600-14400 ticks, but fail-fast validation caps at 10000, so the upper half of the documented design range fails catalog load.
recommended_fix: Raise the cap to cover the documented range (e.g. 20000) or reconcile the documented range with the memory bound; keep the foot-gun rationale explicit either way.

title: Milestone ring and window-elapsed precondition are keyed to absolute run tick and never re-anchored when the gate fires an advance
evidence:
core/era.odin:185-186 (era_gate_sla_ok doc): `// start (the run's setup era = tick 0 for the MVP single advance; the ring` / `// rolls continuously).`
core/era.odin:298 (era_step): `if tick < u64(cat.balance.advance.milestone_window_ticks) {`
core/era.odin:327-329 (the fire path — no era_gate reset): `new_era := state.era_advance_to` / `state.era = new_era` / `state.era_advance_to = 0`
detail: After a fire, the ring keeps pre-era traffic and the window precondition stays elapsed, so a chained advance (era 1→2→3 is reachable with the real 3-era catalog) measures the new era's sustain across the era boundary. Documented MVP scope, but must be fixed before multi-advance eras 4-6.
recommended_fix: At the fire, reset the gate ring/prev/win sums and record an era-start tick; derive the window-elapsed precondition from (tick - era_start_tick) instead of absolute tick.

title: data/balance.json wholesale reformat (indentation, unicode escapes, dropped trailing newline) around a 4-line addition
evidence: diff hunk: `-  "logic_hz": 20,` -> `+ "logic_hz": 20,` (2-space -> 1-space indent); literal `§`/`—` became `\u00a7`/`\u2014` escapes (`+ "_comment": "Balance catalog (GDD \u00a7 Numerical Design, ODN-5). ..."`); and the new side ends with `\ No newline at end of file`. git diff --stat: 93 insertions, 67 deletions for a 4-key addition.
detail: The ODN-5 single source was fully reformatted (indent, escapes, trailing newline) while semantically only the `advance` block changed — the real change is buried in noise and future blame/diff review is harder.
recommended_fix: Restore the original formatting (2-space indent, literal UTF-8, trailing newline) and re-apply only the `advance` block addition; keep the diff minimal.
